artworks.title: Saint John
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure standing upright. The person has long, wavy hair falling over their shoulders and down their back. Their facial features are delicately rendered, with a slight downward gaze. The individual is clad in voluminous, flowing robes that drape elegantly, and they are barefoot. In their right hand, they hold a book, while their left hand holds a large, ornate chalice from which snakes are emerging. A halo surrounds their head, radiating lines outward. The background is simple yet textured, focusing attention on the figure.

artworks.title: Saint James the Great
artworks.description: The image shows an old man with a long, curly beard and wavy hair standing upright. He wears a hat with a scallop shell ornament, a robe with a cloak, a belt, and carries a staff and pouch. The background features radiating lines. The artwork is monochromatic with fine lines for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Saint Andrew
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man sawing through a piece of wood held upright by another individual. The man has long, wavy hair, a full beard, deeply set facial features, a robe, and is focused on the task. The background has radiating lines and minimal ground.

artworks.title: Christ
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in the center. The individual is facing forward with their left hand raised, palm open, and their right hand holding a globe with a cross on top. They have long wavy hair and closed eyes. They are wearing flowing robes that cover their body and feet. The background is filled with clouds, and there are small winged figures among the clouds.

artworks.title: The Bewitched Groom
artworks.description: This is a woodcut drawing depicting a horse standing in a stable-like setting at the top half of the illustration. A figure holding a whip is on the right. In the lower part, a male figure is lying down, holding a scroll in one hand. The drawing is detailed with strong contrasts and intricate linework.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve with Serpent
artworks.description: This is a print of two humans and a snake in a forest setting. The central focus is on a tree with a large serpent coiling around its trunk, its head lowered and its mouth wide open, looking towards a person on the left. To the left and right of the tree stand two nude people, with a man on the left and a woman on the right. The man appears to hold something small behind his back, and his other hand is raised, as if he is speaking with the serpent. On the right, the woman reaches up to pick a piece of fruit from the tree above. The background is filled with trees and foliage, etched in a dense, textured style. The lower right corner features a monogram.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve
artworks.description: The image shows two figures - a man and a woman depicted in a vertical woodcut style. The man is slightly behind and to the left of the woman. Both figures are unclothed, with the woman holding a branch with leaves covering her lower abdomen. They are situated in a textured landscape with a tree trunk and vegetation details. The man stands on a decorative base, while the woman leans against the tree trunk. Textural lines in the background create depth in the scene.

artworks.title: Standing Figure with Extinguished Torches
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of an individual standing and facing slightly right. They have medium-length wavy hair, a simple outline of facial features, wear a loose garment, and hold crossed long rods. They are wearing long pants or a skirt and the background is plain with the artist's signature and date in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Christ in Gethsemane
artworks.description: The image is a monochrome illustration of a male figure from head to knee. The man is on all fours, with detailed facial features showing a shaggy beard and unkempt hair. He wears a flowing, robe-like garment. The background is abstract, with swirling lines and indistinct shapes, possibly representing other figures or creatures.

artworks.title: Study of a Tiger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a tiger. The drawing features a tiger lying down on a patch of ground, gazing directly at the viewer, with a backdrop of a rocky landscape. The tiger's body is stretched out, showcasing its distinctive stripes and elegant form. The scene is rendered with fine detail and shading, capturing the texture of the tiger's coat and the natural environment around it. The landscape has a subtle horizon line, gentle slopes, and sparse vegetation, all depicted with intricate line work. The drawing is bordered by a simple frame with the text "ETUDE DE TIGRE" beneath the image.

artworks.title: The Young White King between the Queen and Princess of the Feuereisen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene depicting a banquet. The image shows a grand dining room with a table laid out with dishes and tableware. The central part of the scene features a table covered with a cloth, plates, goblets, and an assortment of food items. The setting is richly detailed with tapestries on the walls, columns, and checkerboard flooring. Through the windows, buildings are visible, suggesting an urban environment. The woodcut style and intricate line work hint at a Renaissance influence.

artworks.title: A King on a Throne, before him Four Men
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of five individuals. Four standing figures are on the left, and one seated figure is on the right. The seated person is wearing a crown and robes, sitting on an ornately carved chair. This person has a beard and long hair. The standing individuals are dressed in long robes with fur-trimmed hats. They appear to be in conversation with the seated figure. The background includes a large window with an arched design and columns, showing a view of a castle or large building. The floor is patterned, and there is a large draped curtain behind the seated person, indicating an interior with grand decor.

artworks.title: Christ Disputing with the Doctors
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with a central seated figure surrounded by other figures. The composition includes an ornate chair on a raised platform, an archway, columns, open books, and scrolls. The figures are depicted in poses of discussion and contemplation. The style features detailed line work and shading, creating a sense of depth and realism.

artworks.title: Venus and Cupid
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated on a rock, holding an infant in her arms. The woman is positioned sideways, leaning forward, while the child is cradled against her chest. Both figures have soft, rounded facial features. The woman's hair is styled in a wavy manner around her head. She appears to be wearing a loose garment. There are no visible jewelry in their hands. The background shows a detailed natural setting with large trees and lush foliage, creating a woodland atmosphere. There is a small plaque in the lower left corner attributing the artwork to Titian, created by Nicolas Boldrinus in 1567.

artworks.title: Victory Reclining Amid Trophies
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure reclining amidst an array of armor and weapons. The central figure, with wings and partially draped, lies surrounded by a chaotic collection of medieval helmets, shields, spears, and other armor pieces, all rendered with intricate line work. Behind the figure, an array of geometric architectural forms is visible. Above the scene, a symbol that appears to be a heraldic device or possibly a caduceus floats. The drawing exhibits a high level of detail, capturing both the textures of the metallic armor and the softness of the human form. The dynamic composition and allegorical elements suggest themes of war, peace, and possibly transformation.

artworks.title: Satyr's Family
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.4 x 7.9 cm (3 5/16 x 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The scene shows a faun-like figure playing a stringed instrument next to a woman who is holding a small child. The faun has goat-like legs, cloven hooves, a human torso, sharp facial features, a beard, and small horns. He has curly hair. The woman has soft features and wears a head wrap. She is reclined on a grassy mound, holding the child close to her chest. The background is simple with sketched lines indicating a natural setting and sparse vegetation. A caduceus symbol is drawn in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Apollo and Diana
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16 x 10 cm (6 5/16 x 3 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude male figure standing on a curved, lined surface in a dynamic pose. The man is aiming a bow with one foot forward and the other slightly lifted. He has long hair, one arm extended forward, and the other pulling back the bowstring with an arrow near his cheek. The figure wears a quiver of arrows on his back. In the background, there are linear rays, an intricate symbol near his head, and various incised lines.

artworks.title: Two Philosophers
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.9 x 11.1 cm (5 1/16 x 4 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a scholarly setting. The man on the left is depicted from the waist up, sitting upright. He has a long, curly beard and wavy hair. He is dressed in a draped robe, and his right arm is resting on a desk with an open book. The man on the right is shown in a reclined position with only his head and upper body visible above a structure. He has a shorter beard and curly hair, and is also wearing a draped garment. The background is simple, with a wall on one side and a symbol resembling a caduceus above them.

artworks.title: Custodi Nos Dormientes (The Guardian Angel)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.5 x 15.9 cm (8 7/8 x 6 1/4 in.)

artworks.title: Holy Family
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper bodies of three individuals in a drawing or etching. The central figure is seated, looking slightly downward and to the side, with her body angled to the left. She has long wavy hair and gentle facial features. She is draped in flowing, layered clothing and seated on an intricately designed seat. To her left is a child, with curly hair, who is supported by her arm. The child gazes outward with a curious expression. To the right of the central figure, an older man is partially visible, looking toward the woman. He has a long beard and wears a similarly textured robe. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects held by the individuals. In the background, the illustration is plain, with an insignia resembling a caduceus positioned near the upper left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Judith Holding the Head of Holofernes
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing, holding a sword in her right hand, and gripping an older man's head with a beard in her left hand. She has long hair in a braid, wearing a flowing robe that covers her body and head. The woman's eyes are partially closed, with a serene expression. The setting is plain, with just the figures visible.

artworks.title: Caliope (Calliope)
artworks.description: The image shows a person playing a double recorder. The individual's head is tilted slightly, and they are standing with their left leg extended forward and the right leg pulled back. The person has a calm expression and long hair flowing over their shoulders and down their back. They are dressed in a flowing garment, exposing the left shoulder and extending to their bare feet. In the background, there is a landscape with a distant castle-like structure on the left and rocky formations on the right. Next to the person, there is an ornate fountain with flowing water. The scene is enclosed within a decorative border.

artworks.title: Iupiter (Jupiter)
artworks.description: The image is a full-body illustration of a bearded, crowned man seated within an almond-shaped frame. The man holds a scepter in his right hand and rests his left hand on his knee. He has a long beard, long hair flowing beneath the crown, and wears a flowing robe. Above him, an eagle is perched on the almond shape. Surrounding him are smaller figures in armor. In the background, there are rolling hills and distant structures. The border is simple, and the inscription "IVPITER XXXVI" is visible below.
